description: Defines the ProducerQueueChannel class for managing producer queues in buffer hub service, including creation, buffer allocation, and consumer management.

classes.name: ProducerQueueChannel
classes.description: Manages a producer queue in the buffer hub, allowing creation, buffer allocation, insertion, removal, and consumer management.

methods.name: HandleMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages for the producer queue channel.

methods.name: OnCreateConsumerQueue
methods.description: Creates a new consumer queue attached to this producer queue.

methods.name: OnProducerQueueAllocateBuffers
methods.description: Allocates multiple buffers for the producer queue.

methods.name: OnProducerQueueInsertBuffer
methods.description: Inserts a buffer into the queue.

methods.name: OnProducerQueueRemoveBuffer
methods.description: Removes a buffer from the queue.

methods.name: AllocateBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a single buffer for the producer queue.
